summary: The nominal 13-test lane, no-raw-open feature-card check, byte-exact result-pack check, tracked 23/23 mutation report, and 28 independent intended-remediation probes pass. The remediation is nevertheless not closeout-ready. The final validator does not bind the reconstructed PR-152 source card/raw-record root back to the frozen spec pins, accepts deep-replay receipts that explicitly report failure or omit required completeness/integrity fields, and records a result-pack generating command that omits thread variables incorporated into the cache key. Two independently reproduced P1 false-green paths and one P2 reproducibility defect therefore remain.

remediation_findings.title: Final reconstruction is not rooted to the frozen PR-152 card hash or raw-record root

evidence.observation: The frozen spec pins both the PR-152 release-card SHA-256 and raw_records_only_sha256=63b65bfd...2968.
_expected_units_from_pr152 loads the current card and returns its derived records/root without checking the card bytes or derived root against either frozen spec pin.

validate_feature_card compares card authentication and cache identity only to that mutable current-card reconstruction; it never requires raw_root equal spec.source_authorities.pr152_release_card.raw_records_only_sha256.

reproduced_behavior.method: In memory, change the authenticated observed source SHA-256, recompute a canonical raw_records_only_root, reconstruct a new canonical cache identity, and consistently reseal all 401 cache envelopes, feature-card cache bindings, resource-history cache key, and deep-replay card/root bindings. Dependency injection supplies the equivalently changed PR-152 authority reconstruction; no file is edited.

remediation_findings.impact: A changed PR-152 source authority can become the validator's new truth while the frozen PR-177 spec remains unchanged. The result pack can then accept a different source identity under coordinated resealing, violating the exact-source eligibility gate and leaving the original cache-identity P1 only partially remediated.
remediation_findings.required_change: Authenticate PR152_CARD_PATH bytes against the frozen spec SHA-256, validate its embedded manifest self-hash/cross-pin as the producer does, and require the independently derived raw root to equal the frozen raw_records_only_sha256 before constructing expected_identity. Validate the matching frozen authority hashes in feature-card input_hashes and deep-replay provenance.
tests_to_add: Reject a resealed changed PR-152 card even when its embedded root is internally canonical.
Reject coordinated source-card, feature-card, all-cache, and deep-replay resealing when the resulting raw root differs from the frozen spec root.
Reject PR-152 card-byte drift independently of raw-record equality.
remediation_findings.kill_switch: Do not accept the PR-177 scientific terminal until a fresh independent replay demonstrates that frozen PR-152 card/root drift is rejected.

remediation_findings.title: Deep-replay validation accepts an explicitly failed or incomplete replay receipt

evidence.observation: The producer emits PASS_AUTHORITATIVE_401_UNIT_FEATURE_REPLAY, 401 raw stat checks, 401 raw opens, zero hashes, and nested signed resource receipts.
_deep_replay_errors checks several count/identity claims but omits process_execution_status, scientific_status, raw_payload_stat_checks, and required presence of each nested resource semantic digest.
resource_receipt_errors verifies a semantic digest only if the field is present, so persisted receipts with the field deleted are accepted.

reproduced_behavior.mutation: Set deep-replay process_execution_status to FAIL and reseal the outer receipt.
Set raw_payload_stat_checks to 0 and reseal the outer receipt.
Delete the nested resource receipt semantic_digest and reseal the outer receipt.

remediation_findings.impact: The scientific result builder can accept provenance whose own process status says FAIL or whose required source-stat/integrity evidence is absent. This is a direct false green in the new authoritative-replay gate, so the complete 401-unit replay and nested-resource P1 are not fail-closed.
remediation_findings.required_change: Require the exact deep-replay PASS process/scientific statuses, exact raw_payload_stat_checks=401, exact feature-card path and frozen input bindings, and a present valid semantic_digest on every persisted resource receipt. Keep the pre-seal internal receipt check separate from persisted-envelope validation.
tests_to_add: Reject deep-replay FAIL, missing, or unknown process status after outer reseal.
Reject zero, missing, non-integer, or wrong raw_payload_stat_checks.
Reject a deleted nested resource semantic_digest after outer reseal.
Register these probes in the generated mutation report, not only unit tests.
remediation_findings.kill_switch: Do not treat the deep-replay receipt as terminal eligibility evidence until these fail-closed checks and mutations pass independently.

remediation_findings.title: Recorded result-pack generating command omits runtime variables embedded in the cache key

evidence.observation: OMP_NUM_THREADS, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS, and MKL_NUM_THREADS are included in runtime_identity and therefore the canonical cache key.
Every result artifact records a generating_command that sets only PYTHONPATH and omits all three required thread variables.

reproduced_behavior.method: Run the recorded command's non-mutating --check equivalent in a sanitized inherited environment with the three thread variables unset.
reproduced_behavior.first_error: cache identity does not match frozen reconstruction
reproduced_behavior.additional_errors: resource-history/cache-key and per-unit pipeline/key mismatches follow because the reconstructed runtime identity differs.

remediation_findings.impact: The mandatory generating command is not self-contained and cannot reproduce the artifact on the reviewed host unless undocumented inherited environment happens to match. This weakens the runtime-provenance remediation even though the cache itself is correctly runtime-bound.
remediation_findings.required_change: Record the exact three thread assignments, and any other required deterministic environment such as MPLCONFIGDIR, in _common_metadata.generating_command. Add a test that executes the recorded command from a sanitized environment using --check.
remediation_findings.kill_switch: Do not describe the current result-pack generating_command as directly reproducible.
